elements.text: Newsroom
Apple introduces iPhone 18 Pro and iPhone 18 Pro Max
CUPERTINO, CALIFORNIA. 9 September 2026.

Apple today announced iPhone 18 Pro and iPhone 18 Pro Max, powered by A20 Pro, the first Apple chip built on a 2-nanometre process. The new models introduce a 48MP main camera with a variable aperture, a 5x periscope telephoto, and 8K ProRes recording direct to external storage.

"iPhone 18 Pro is the most capable camera we have ever put in a phone, and A20 Pro makes it the fastest," said a spokesperson for Apple. "It runs the largest on-device models we have shipped while lasting longer on a charge than any iPhone before it."
Pricing and availability

iPhone 18 Pro starts at $999 and iPhone 18 Pro Max at $1,199, in Natural, Black, Desert and Blue titanium, with 256GB, 512GB, 1TB and 2TB options. Pre-orders open Friday 11 September with availability Friday 18 September.

elements.text: Newsroom
Apple unveils MacBook Air with M5
CUPERTINO, CALIFORNIA. 3 March 2026.

Apple today updated MacBook Air with the M5 chip, bringing a 10-core CPU, a 10-core GPU with hardware ray tracing, and a neural engine twice as fast as M4. The 13-inch and 15-inch models keep the fanless design and now reach 18 hours of battery life.
Both sizes gain a 12MP Center Stage camera, support for two external displays with the lid open, and Wi-Fi 7. The new Sky Blue finish joins Midnight, Starlight and Silver.
Pricing and availability
The 13-inch MacBook Air with M5 starts at $1,099 and the 15-inch at $1,299. Both are available to order today and in stores from 12 March.

Privacy. That's Apple.
Privacy is a fundamental human right, and one of our core values. Our products are designed to keep your data on your device and to give you control over what is shared.
How Apple products protect you

On-device processing: Siri requests, photo analysis and Apple Intelligence features run on the device wherever possible. Requests that need more compute go to Private Cloud Compute, where the data is never stored and never available to Apple.
App Tracking Transparency: apps must ask before tracking you across other companies' apps and websites.
Mail Privacy Protection hides your IP address from senders; Safari blocks cross-site tracking by default; Hide My Email creates unique addresses that forward to your inbox.
Your data
Download a copy of your data, correct it, or delete your account at any time from your Apple Account settings. Apple does not sell your data and never has.
